title: Linux fleet — HTTP / nginx + served hostnames audit

body.sql: SELECT s.hostname AS node_hostname, s.uuid AS node_uuid, l.port AS port, l.address AS address, l.protocol AS protocol, p.pid AS pid, p.name AS process_name, p.path AS process_path, p.cmdline AS cmdline FROM system_info s, listening_ports l, processes p WHERE l.pid = p.pid AND l.protocol = 6 AND l.port > 0

SELECT s.hostname AS node_hostname, s.uuid AS node_uuid, p.pid AS pid, p.name AS process_name, p.path AS process_path, p.cmdline AS cmdline, p.start_time AS start_time FROM system_info s, processes p WHERE p.name LIKE '%nginx%' OR p.path LIKE '%nginx%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%nginx%' OR p.name LIKE '%apache%' OR p.name LIKE '%httpd%' OR p.name LIKE '%caddy%' OR p.name LIKE '%lighttpd%' OR p.name LIKE '%traefik%' OR p.name LIKE '%haproxy%' OR p.name LIKE '%envoy%' OR p.name LIKE '%gunicorn%' OR p.name LIKE '%uvicorn%' OR p.name LIKE '%tomcat%'

SELECT s.hostname AS node_hostname, s.uuid AS node_uuid, c.id AS container_id, c.name AS container_name, c.image AS image, c.state AS state, c.status AS status, pt.port AS container_port, pt.host_port AS host_port, pt.host_ip AS host_ip, pt.type AS port_type FROM system_info s, docker_containers c LEFT JOIN docker_container_ports pt ON pt.id = c.id

nodes.title: Per node: nginx config files + docker labels/env

body.sql: SELECT s.hostname AS node_hostname, 'file' AS source, f.path AS ref, 'config_file' AS label, f.path AS value FROM system_info s, file f WHERE f.path LIKE '/etc/nginx/%%' OR f.path LIKE '/etc/apache2/sites-enabled/%%' OR f.path LIKE '/etc/httpd/conf.d/%%' OR f.path LIKE '/etc/caddy/%%' UNION ALL SELECT s.hostname, 'docker_label', l.id, l.key, l.value FROM system_info s, docker_container_labels l UNION ALL SELECT s.hostname, 'docker_env', e.id, e.key, e.value FROM system_info s, docker_container_envs e

nodes.title: Per node: nginx server_name via augeas

body.sql: SELECT s.hostname AS node_hostname, a.path AS ref, a.label AS label, a.value AS value, a.node AS aug_node FROM system_info s, augeas a WHERE a.path = '/etc/nginx/nginx.conf'

nodes.title: Per node: TLS cert CN + SANs

body.sql: SELECT s.hostname AS node_hostname, c.hostname AS probe, c.common_name AS common_name, c.subject_alternative_names AS sans, c.issuer_common_name AS issuer FROM system_info s, curl_certificate c WHERE c.hostname = '{{$this.tls_target}}'

SELECT s.hostname AS node_hostname, s.uuid AS node_uuid, 'system' AS source, o.name AS name, o.version AS value FROM system_info s, os_version o UNION ALL SELECT s.hostname, s.uuid, 'etc_hosts', h.address, h.hostnames FROM system_info s, etc_hosts h
